title: Sukkah 5a — Practice Quiz
source: Questions and correct answers taken directly from the Dafyomi Advancement Forum quiz for Sukkah 5 (dafyomi.co.il/sukah/quiz/su-qz-005.htm), questions 1–3.

questions.q: "Hashem neither comes all the way down to Eretz, nor does man ascend all the way up to Shamayim."
questions.explain: Every apparent counter-verse is reread as stopping right at the 10-tefachim line — neither side ever actually crosses it.

questions.q: From where do we learn the height (thickness) of the kaporet (Ark cover)?
options: Misgeret, seeing as it was a kli
Misgeret is the smallest object whose measurement is stated
Al p'nei ha'kaporet, and panim is a tefach
questions.explain: Two independent derivations survive: the table's border (the smallest measured vessel-dimension in the Mishkan) and Rav Huna's "face" wordplay. The answer is genuinely disputed between those two, not settled on one.
Both positions appear in the Gemara's own phrasing ("according to the one who said it was above...") — genuinely disputed, not resolved to one side.
